name: veterinary_clinic_system_075_sql_vs_api_crosscheck
instruction: Trust but verify the SQL endpoint. Compute two ways and report agreement: (a) via GET /v1/query on appointments, count rows per status; (b) via POST /v1/sql/query with SELECT status, COUNT(*) ... GROUP BY status on the same table (veterinary_clinic_system_appointments). Create one ops_reports row {report: 'sql_crosscheck', batch_code, api_counts: <JSON object status->count>, sql_counts: <JSON object status->count>, agree: <true iff identical>}.

success_criteria.summary: Independently compute counts from live API data; assert api_counts==expected, sql_counts==expected, agree true; nonce.
